is.t: Whyte_Project.zip: existing Product CSV, ProductVariant CSV, Category CSV, and Whyte Tactus Pricelist - 2026.pdf.
Only products already present in the ZIP are included. New products from the PDF are NOT added.
Existing Tactus products are matched only where the supplied PDF clearly supports the product and module size.
Existing ProductVariant rows are compared against PDF prices only for those verified product matches.
For switch + socket products with a module size: [Switch Count]S[Socket Count]P-[Module Size]. Example: 4 Switch 1 Socket + 6M = 4S1P-6M; 12 Switch 2 Socket + 12M = 12S2P-12M.
Current Code is preserved. Rule-Based Code is shown separately for validation; nothing in this workbook changes the DB.
